apps.description: Scope 1-2-3 carbon accounting — automated emissions collection, factor libraries, audit-ready ledgers.
ESG report builder — GRI/CSRD/SASB mapping, evidence collection, one-click disclosure drafts.
Building energy audit copilot — anomaly detection on meters, retrofit ROI ranking, rebate matching.
Sustainable procurement — supplier ESG scoring, green spend analytics, eco-label verification.
Circular economy planner — waste stream valorization, take-back program design, material passports.
Climate risk assessor — physical & transition risk scoring per asset/portfolio, TCFD-ready outputs.
Green fleet optimizer — EV transition planning, route emissions minimization, TCO vs CO2 trade-offs.
